opening: I've been getting fevers every day.
It's been about a year; it had already been going on for 6 months when I first came to the clinic.
The fevers, tiredness and other general symptoms came on within the last 6 months; when I first came to the clinic about the hives, I had no general symptoms.

opening.text: I've had chronic hives, or urticaria, for about a year now; it had already been going on for six months when I first came to the clinic. I've been getting fevers every day, and the fevers, tiredness, and other general symptoms came on within the last six months. When I first came to the clinic about the hives, I had no general symptoms.
